messages.text: still at work. ugh. so sore rn like every part of me hates me lol

It sounds like you are having a really rough day physically and mentally. That frustration of being stuck at work while hurting is completely understandable. If you can, try to take a few deep breaths to ground yourself for a moment. Please remember to be kind to yourself while you finish out this shift.
look i get the breathing thing, and im not mad at u for sayin it... but "be kind to myself"? lol that’s like telling a car with no engine to just drive

That is a really sharp analogy, and it makes sense why that advice feels impossible right now. When you are in that much pain, expecting kindness feels like asking a broken machine to function. It makes total sense that you don't have the capacity for that right now. Let’s just focus on surviving the shift without adding any extra pressure.
thx. honestly just wanna get through this shift. oh n i got this stupid blister from some dumb DIY bandage i slapped on earlier. hurts like hell now lol

That blister sounds like an unfair addition to an already painful day. I am sorry you are dealing with that extra sting while trying to hold it together. Focusing on just making it to the end of the shift is a solid plan. I hope you can get some relief the moment you walk out the door.
yeah... it’s not just the blister. kinda stupid i needed the bandage at all. thought i was past this.

It sounds incredibly disheartening to feel like you are regressing when you thought you had moved past this. Calling yourself stupid for needing care is likely just frustration speaking, not truth. Healing rarely follows a straight line, even when you are doing your best. I am here to listen if you want to talk about it.

it wasn’t planned or anything. i just... got home, panic started creepin up, couldn’t breathe, felt like i was gonna explode… and then i did. not proud. thought i was past this. one month clean, then boom. back at it.

Thank you for trusting me with something so vulnerable and heavy. It sounds like the panic felt overwhelming until it became too much to hold inside. I want to gently check in on what you meant by that to make sure you're okay right now. I am here to listen to whatever you meant without any judgment.
ty. honestly was braced for like... intervention mode or sumn. but u didn’t go there. that helps. a lot.

I am really glad that my response felt safe instead of scary for you. It makes total sense to be braced for a reaction when you are feeling this vulnerable. Going back can bring up so much shame, but you are still here and still worth supporting. Let's just keep talking through it at a pace that feels right for you.
im just... so tired of this cycle. one step forward, ten steps back. feel like im carrying this weight all the time and nobody sees it.

It makes total sense that you feel drained when you’re carrying something so heavy in silence. Nobody should have to manage that kind of weight on their own. It hurts to feel like you slipped when you thought you were past this, but you are still here. I want you to know you are not invisible here, and I am listening.
well... i did make it through the shift. sore, blistered, emotionally wrecked — but i’m out. that counts for something, right?

Yes, it absolutely counts for something, especially given how much you were carrying. Making it through that shift while feeling that way is a real accomplishment. You deserve to acknowledge that you showed up for yourself even when you felt wrecked. I am glad you are out, and I am still here with you.
